Proof. Proof of q beta c 2 eq neg one structural

Proof (algebraic identity)

The operator-valued N{=}2 correction to \mathfrak{Q}_\beta (per the brane-tower truncation of the canonical formalism) is the factor (1 - b^2 \cdot \hbar_q^4). With u_{\text{ladder}} = b \cdot \hbar_q^2, direct expansion gives

1 - b^2 \cdot \hbar_q^4
\;=\; 1 - (b \cdot \hbar_q^2)^2
\;=\; 1 - u_{\text{ladder}}^2.

This is a one-line ring identity in any commutative ring containing b and \hbar_q. Comparing to the ladder ansatz 1 + c_2 \cdot u_{\text{ladder}}^2 + O(u_{\text{ladder}}^3) at order u_{\text{ladder}}^2 forces c_2 = -1. \blacksquare
